representation.plain_text: Algorithm 1 Task-specific Toolset Optimization 1: Input: Toolbox D = {di} n i=1 , base toolset Dbase 2: Output: Optimized toolset D * 3: # Stage 1: Baseline setup 4: Accbaseline ← Acc(Dbase) 5: # Stage 2: Individual tool evaluation 6: for each di in D such that di / ∈ Dbase do 7: Di ← Dbase ∪ {di} 8: Acci ← Acc(Di) 9: ∆ d i ← Acci -Accbaseline 10: if ∆ d i > 0 then 11:
∆ d i = Acc D i -Acc D base .(1)
D * = D base ∪ { d i | ∆ d i > 0}.(2)
